annotations.text:
Bohra Masjid Finder — restyled to the community portal template.

Navy #0E2B49 bar and card header strips, gold #E8C061 uppercase headings with an arabesque watermark, cream #FAF7EC ground, white cards with soft shadows.

Masjid entries are real, from data/masjids.json. Mockup only — no code changed.
No fake status bar drawn — on a real phone the OS renders its own on top. All tap targets are 44px or larger.
